candidates.source_name: Národná banka Slovenska – Profil verejného obstarávateľa (own site)
candidates.why_relevant: Central bank's own procurement hub: states that all above-threshold tenders run through IS JOSEPHINE, publishes standard tender conditions (dated 1.10.2025), links to its UVO profile and to sub-pages for contracts/orders/invoices and selected tenders. Direct visibility into NBS demand for cash-handling, banknote processing, payment/clearing and IT systems.
candidates.legal_status: public mandatory disclosure under Act 343/2015 Z.z.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML crawl of the procurement section tree (profil, PTK, zmluvy/objednávky/faktúry, vybrané verejné súťaže); diff page listings weekly.
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska verejné obstarávanie profil obstarávateľa

candidates.source_name: NBS – Prípravné trhové konzultácie (preliminary market consultations)
candidates.why_relevant: Earliest possible signal: NBS publishes PTK pages 6-18 months BEFORE a tender, with draft technical specs and supplier Q&A. Observed PTKs include DMS (2022, 2025), multifunction printing devices, catering, cleaning — i.e. it captures IT/document/hardware demand before the notice reaches the Vestník.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the PTK index page and each PTK child page; capture attached specification PDFs; alert on new child URLs.
queries_used: "prípravné trhové konzultácie" NBS nbs.sk verejné obstarávanie

candidates.source_name: NBS – Zmluvy, objednávky, faktúry (contracts, orders, invoices)
candidates.why_relevant: NBS is exempt from the Centrálny register zmlúv and instead publishes contracts/orders/invoices on its own site under Act 546/2010. This is therefore the ONLY route to NBS supplier names and contract values — critical for mapping incumbent vendors in cash handling and banking IT.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Paginated crawl of the zmluvy sub-register; parse counterparty, subject, value, date; likely PDF attachments needing OCR-free text extraction.
queries_used: "Národná banka Slovenska" crz.gov.sk zmluvy centrálny register zmlúv objednávky faktúry

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Profil verejného obstarávateľa NBS (profile ID 8643)
candidates.why_relevant: The legally authoritative mirror of NBS procurement documents on the regulator's platform, with a stable numeric profile ID (8643) that makes long-term automated monitoring feasible independently of NBS website redesigns.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll profile detail page by ID; prefer the ÚVO/ISEPVO API or eForms XML feeds over HTML scraping; headless browser fallback for the SPA.
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska verejné obstarávanie profil obstarávateľa

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Profil verejného obstarávateľa SZRB (profile ID 9586)
candidates.why_relevant: SZRB's own procurement page explicitly points here as its profile. SZRB has recently tendered a Core Banking System (~EUR 2.95m) and a regulatory reporting IS — exactly the banking-technology demand this cell exists to capture.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Same ID-based polling as NBS profile; cross-reference each notice with uvostat and CRZ for awarded value and winner.
queries_used: Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka verejné obstarávanie profil

candidates.source_name: SZRB – Obstarávanie prác, tovarov a služieb
candidates.why_relevant: SZRB's own procurement landing page, confirming it applies Act 343/2015 and linking to its ÚVO profile, summary reports and its orders/invoices register. Entry point for snowballing SZRB IT tenders.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly HTML crawl of /obstaravanie_prac_tovarov_sluzieb/, /sk/suhrnne-spravy-o-zakazkach/ and /faktury/.
queries_used: Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka verejné obstarávanie profil

candidates.source_name: SZRB – Súhrnné správy o zákazkach (summary reports on low-value contracts)
candidates.why_relevant: Quarterly summary reports capture the below-threshold contracts that never reach the Vestník or TED — often the small maintenance/licence/service deals that reveal which vendors already sit inside the bank.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly fetch of listed PDF/XLS summary reports; tabular parse of supplier + subject + value.
queries_used: Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka verejné obstarávanie profil

candidates.source_name: EXIMBANKA SR – Profil verejného obstarávateľa
candidates.why_relevant: Eximbanka's own four-level profile, splitting nadlimitné/podlimitné zákazky, §9 ods.9 contracts and summary reports on contracts over EUR 1,000/year. Contact for discrepancies: preti@eximbanka.sk. Covers a state export bank's IT, insurance-system and service demand.
candidates.access_status: open; legacy CMS with query-string page_id navigation and PDF leaves
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the page_id tree; harvest linked PDFs; be tolerant of URL churn (site also serves eximbanka.sk/wp-content/ PDFs, suggesting a partial WordPress migration).
queries_used: Eximbanka SR verejné obstarávanie profil verejného obstarávateľa

candidates.source_name: IS JOSEPHINE (PROEBIZ) – e-procurement platform used by NBS
candidates.why_relevant: NBS states that ALL its above-threshold tenders are conducted in IS JOSEPHINE; tender detail pages carry the actual documentation, deadlines and Q&A. Confirmed NBS tenders visible here include 'Servis zariadení na spracovanie bankoviek' (banknote-processing equipment servicing) and 'Agendové systémy dohľadu a regulácie' (supervision/regulation case systems) — the two highest-value signal types for this cell.
candidates.access_status: public tender list open; full documentation typically requires free registration as záujemca
candidates.legal_status: platform ToS apply; public list pages appear freely readable
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the public-tenders list filtered/sorted by promoter for the four banks; store tender IDs and fetch /tender/{id}/summary. Respect rate limits; do not attempt authenticated areas without an account decision.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from NBS profile statement + sk search
queries_used: NBS Josephine ERANET zákazka spracovanie bankoviek obstarávanie 2025

candidates.source_name: Vestník verejného obstarávania (ÚVO official procurement bulletin, eForms)
candidates.why_relevant: The legally definitive daily publication of Slovak procurement notices, now fed by the eForms IS and full-text searchable. Every notice from NBS, Eximbanka, SZRB and SIH above threshold must appear here first; it is the canonical timestamp for a tender's existence.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily ingest of issue pages (observed numbering e.g. 45/2026, 67/2026); prefer eForms XML/structured export if exposed, otherwise full-text query on the four entity names and their IČO.
queries_used: Vestník úradu pre verejné obstarávanie oznámenie o vyhlásení verejného obstarávania banka IT systém 2026

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Vyhľadávanie zákaziek (contract search)
candidates.why_relevant: Entity- and CPV-filterable search across all Slovak notices; the practical query interface for building a standing watchlist on the four state banks and on CPV codes for banking software, banknote handling and security printing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Reverse-engineer the JSON endpoint behind the SPA; query by IČO (NBS, SZRB 00682420, Eximbanka, SIH) and by CPV 48000000/30160000/72000000/79800000.
queries_used: Vestník úradu pre verejné obstarávanie oznámenie o vyhlásení verejného obstarávania banka IT systém 2026

candidates.source_name: IS EPVO / EVO portal (evo.isepvo.sk) – state e-procurement system
candidates.why_relevant: The state-run electronic procurement system; contracting authorities that do not use JOSEPHINE (likely SZRB/Eximbanka for some procedures) run tenders here, with a public order-search view exposing procedure documents.
candidates.access_status: public search open; participation requires registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll public OrderSearch filtered by contracting authority name; capture procedure IDs and attached documentation.
queries_used: Vestník úradu pre verejné obstarávanie oznámenie o vyhlásení verejného obstarávania banka IT systém 2026

candidates.source_name: UVOstat – entity dossier for SZRB (IČO 00682420) and other authorities
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party aggregator that restructures ÚVO data into per-entity dossiers (tenders, contracts, finances, supplier connections). Far easier to parse than the ÚVO SPA and gives historical award series and winning-supplier links for the state banks.
candidates.legal_status: derived from public open data; verify against ÚVO before citing
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /subjekt/{ICO} and /obstaravatel/{id} pages for the four banks; treat as convenience index, always reconcile values with the Vestník.
queries_used: uvostat.sk Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka Exportno-importná banka verejné obstarávania

candidates.source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) – SZRB, Eximbanka, SIH contract records
candidates.why_relevant: Full text of signed contracts (supplier, price, scope, annexes) for the state banks — the outcome layer that closes the loop on a tender. NOTE the asymmetry: NBS holds an exemption from CRZ and publishes on its own site instead, so CRZ covers SZRB/Eximbanka/SIH but not NBS.
candidates.legal_status: official public register (contracts effective day after publication)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use CRZ per-entity pages plus its open-data/API export; filter by counterparty and by keywords (informačný systém, licencie, servis, bankomaty, tlač).
queries_used: "Národná banka Slovenska" crz.gov.sk zmluvy centrálny register zmlúv objednávky faktúry
"Eximbanka" OR "EXIMBANKA SR" josephine.proebiz.com OR ezakazky.sk verejné obstarávanie zákazka IT

candidates.source_name: TED / Supplement to the Official Journal of the EU – SK state-bank notices
candidates.why_relevant: Above-threshold notices from all four entities are duplicated to TED; SIH explicitly states that its NDF II procurements are published in the EU Official Journal Supplement. TED offers structured eForms data and a stable API — the most machine-friendly channel for this cell.
candidates.legal_status: official EU public register, reuse permitted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED Search API with country=SK plus buyer-name queries for the four institutions and CPV filters; ingest eForms XML directly rather than scraping HTML.

candidates.source_name: Slovak Investment Holding – Výber finančných sprostredkovateľov (NDF II)
candidates.why_relevant: SIH procures differently from the other three: instead of technology, it runs public procurements and open calls to SELECT FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES for instruments (FLPG for R&D&I, energy-efficiency credit instruments, social-economy guarantees). Useful as a map of which Slovak banks are contracting with the state, and occasionally for fund-administration/IT services.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the vyber-financnych-sprostredkovatelov page plus /aktuality feed; cross-link each announcement to its TED notice.

candidates.why_relevant: Slovak financial newswire that reliably reports state-bank tenders with values and scope — e.g. SZRB's core banking system tender (~EUR 2.95m) and its new reporting information system. Gives narrative context and sometimes names bidders before award notices publish.
candidates.access_status: open web; some content may be metered
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted news — link and summarise, do not republish
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/keyword monitoring on the vofinanciach section and the SZRB/NBS entity tag pages; store headline+URL+date, quote sparingly.

candidates.why_relevant: Aggregator that mirrors individual Slovak tenders as stable, crawlable static pages — useful as a historical archive when ÚVO/JOSEPHINE pages rotate. The example is precisely an NBS banknote-processing-equipment servicing tender.

candidates.why_relevant: Establishes the ownership/control chain that makes these banks contracting authorities at all (MF SR exercises shareholder rights; SIH is wholly owned by SZRB). Useful for keeping the actor map correct after mergers or restructurings, and as a pointer to annual reports and governance documents that foreshadow investment programmes.

candidates.why_relevant: The master directory that resolves any Slovak contracting authority name/IČO to a stable profile ID. Needed to pin down the Eximbanka and SIH profile IDs (not yet resolved in this pass) and to detect newly registered state financial entities.

negative_findings.description: Could not resolve the ÚVO profile detail IDs for EXIMBANKA SR and Slovak Investment Holding in this pass. NBS (8643) and SZRB (9586) were resolved; the ÚVO profile search is a JavaScript SPA that did not yield the other two IDs through search-engine results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two of four target authorities lack a stable ÚVO profile ID.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without profile IDs the monitoring pipeline must fall back on name-string matching, which is fragile across diacritics and legal-name variants (EXIMBANKA SR / Exportno-importná banka Slovenskej republiky).

negative_findings.description: The e-procurement platform used by SZRB, Eximbanka and SIH was not established. NBS is confirmed on IS JOSEPHINE; szrb.sk names no platform and points only to its ÚVO profile, and one eTrhovisko (ezakazky.sk) item page appeared in an SZRB-context search without confirmation of the link.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only 1 of 4 authorities has a confirmed tendering platform.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Tender documentation, deadlines and supplier Q&A live on the platform, not in the notice; not knowing the platform means only shallow notice-level coverage for three of four banks.

negative_findings.description: An English-language search for NBS notices on TED returned only generic TED documentation and commercial TED-reseller pages, no actual notice URLs. TED's own search is a JS application not indexed usefully by web search.
negative_findings.result_summary: TED coverage asserted structurally (SIH confirms EU OJ publication) but no specific notice URL captured.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: TED is the best structured/API channel for this cell; it must be exercised through its API rather than via web search, and that has not been validated here.

negative_findings.description: NBS holds an exemption from the Centrálny register zmlúv and publishes contracts/orders/invoices only on nbs.sk under Act 546/2010, whereas SZRB, Eximbanka and SIH appear in CRZ.
negative_findings.result_summary: No single register covers all four authorities' contracts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A CRZ-only pipeline would silently miss the single most interesting buyer in the cell (the central bank). Two separate collectors are required.

negative_findings.description: The English string 'Exim Bank' is heavily polluted: searches return Exim Bank Tanzania, Uganda, Bangladesh and Exim Bank Group. Similarly 'NBS' collides with UK/Serbian building societies and 'SIH' is a common acronym.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only querying on these actor names is unreliable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the mandatory-local-language rule for this cell: queries must use 'EXIMBANKA SR', 'Exportno-importná banka Slovenskej republiky', 'Národná banka Slovenska', 'Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka' and IČO numbers, not English acronyms.

negative_findings.description: Both NBS and Eximbanka run parallel URL schemes: nbs.sk/o-narodnej-banke/verejne-obstaravanie/... alongside legacy www.nbs.sk/sk/verejne-obstaravanie/...; eximbanka.sk serves both a query-string CMS (?page_id=) and WordPress /wp-content/ PDFs.
negative_findings.result_summary: Duplicate/legacy URL trees observed on two of four target sites.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collectors keyed on one tree may quietly go stale or double-count; canonicalisation rules are needed, and old bookmarks should not be assumed dead on a single 404.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed tendering platform for SZRB, Eximbanka SR or SIH.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Open one recent notice for each authority from the Vestník or its ÚVO profile and read the 'komunikácia a výmena informácií' section, which names the platform (JOSEPHINE / IS EPVO-EVO / eZakazky / ERANET); record it in the actor map.

coverage_gaps.description: No API/open-data endpoint validated for ÚVO (ISEPVO/eForms), CRZ or TED in this pass; all findings rest on HTML.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test the ÚVO eForms/open-data exports, the CRZ open-data download, and the TED Search API with country=SK and buyer-name filters; prefer these over scraping the SPAs.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code list has been fixed for this cell's technology interests (banknote processing and sorting machines, security printing, ATM/cash equipment, core banking software, payment clearing systems).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a CPV shortlist (e.g. 30160000 magnetic cards, 30132000, 48000000 software, 48100000, 66000000 financial services, 79800000 printing/security printing, 50000000 repair and maintenance) and use it as a standing filter across ÚVO and TED, independent of buyer name.

coverage_gaps.description: PTK (preliminary market consultation) coverage is confirmed only for NBS; it is unknown whether SZRB, Eximbanka or SIH publish PTKs at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'prípravné trhové konzultácie' plus each institution name and check the ÚVO PTK section; if absent, record it explicitly so the pipeline does not silently assume coverage.

coverage_gaps.description: Not covered: ÚVO revision/appeal decisions (rozhodnutia, námietky) and NKÚ SR audit reports on state financial institutions, both of which expose contested and cancelled tenders — often the most informative cases.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add ÚVO 'Rozhodnutia' / 'Register konečných užívateľov výhod' and NKÚ SR (nku.gov.sk) report search to a follow-up scouting pass for this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: NBS as a Eurosystem NCB may participate in ECB/Eurosystem joint procurement (e.g. banknote-related tenders published by the ECB), which would not surface in Slovak registers at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the ECB procurement portal and Eurosystem joint-procurement notices in a separate pass and link them to NBS as participating NCB.

brief: Slovakia's four state-owned/controlled financial institutions are all subject to Act 343/2015 Z.z., so their procurement is unusually legible: each maintains a profil verejného obstarávateľa both on its own site and on the ÚVO portal (NBS = profile 8643, SZRB = 9586; Eximbanka and SIH IDs still unresolved), with notices duplicated into the daily Vestník and, above threshold, into TED. The richest and earliest signal sits with NBS, which publishes preliminary market consultations (PTK) months before tendering and runs all above-threshold procedures in IS JOSEPHINE — where confirmed tenders include banknote-processing equipment servicing and supervision/regulation case systems. A key structural asymmetry: NBS is exempt from the Centrálny register zmlúv and discloses contracts, orders and invoices only on nbs.sk, while SZRB, Eximbanka and SIH appear in CRZ, so award-side collection needs two distinct paths. SIH is a different animal — it procures financial intermediaries rather than technology — and aggregators (uvostat.sk, sk.openprocurements.com, verejnesutaze.sk) plus SITA Financie serve as convenience indexes and narrative context, never as primary evidence.
